request.todaysMoments: Maya lost her first wobbly tooth at lunch today and is a little nervous about her first dentist visit tomorrow morning.

pages.text: Maya ran her tongue over the little gap where her tooth used to be. Tomorrow was dentist day, and her tummy felt full of butterflies. "I remember feeling fluttery before," she said. "Last time, I took a slow breath and it helped." She breathed in… and out. A little better already.
pages.illustrationPrompt: A five-year-old Black girl with curly dark hair in two puffs, wearing yellow star pajamas, sits cross-legged on a cozy bed, eyes gently closed, taking a calm breath. A tiny round sky-blue dragon with stubby wings, a pale yellow belly and big friendly eyes sits beside her, mirroring the slow breath with a tiny puffed chest. Soft warm lamplight, peaceful bedroom, quiet and reassuring mood.

pages.text: Pip let out a small hiccup. Golden sparkles floated up like tiny stars. "You already did the brave thing once," Pip said. "That makes you luminous — that means glowing on the inside." Maya giggled. "Then let's glow a little more tonight!"

A five-year-old Black girl with curly dark hair in two puffs, wearing yellow star pajamas, laughs with delight, her hands cupped to catch a sparkle. title: The Morning of the Missing Tooth
dedication: For Maya, who was brave enough to smile with a gap today.

choice.question: Where should Maya and Pip go to feel brave tonight — up to Moonberry Hill to talk to the moon, or into the Pillow Fort to practice for tomorrow?

pages.text: Maya and Pip tiptoed up Moonberry Hill. The big round moon hung low and friendly, like it was leaning in to listen. "I have a gap in my smile," Maya told the moon. "And tomorrow a dentist will peek inside." The moon seemed to glow a little warmer, as if to say: I see you, and you are just right.
pages.illustrationPrompt: A five-year-old Black girl with curly dark hair in two puffs, wearing yellow star pajamas, stands at the top of a gentle grassy hill at night, looking up at a large warm full moon in a star-filled sky. A tiny round sky-blue dragon with stubby wings and a pale yellow belly stands close beside her, both gazing upward with wonder. Soft moonlight washes the hill in silver and gold, calm and magical.

pages.text: Pip curled up small and warm against Maya's side. "The moon has seen every brave child who ever grew a new tooth," Pip whispered. Maya yawned a wide, gap-toothed yawn. The stars winked slowly, one by one. Tomorrow felt smaller now — soft and easy and fine. Goodnight, Maya. Sleep tight under all those friendly stars.
pages.illustrationPrompt: A five-year-old Black girl with curly dark hair in two puffs, wearing yellow star pajamas, lies back on the soft grassy top of a gentle moonlit hill, eyes drowsy and closing. A tiny round sky-blue dragon with stubby wings and a pale yellow belly is curled up snugly against her side, eyes half-shut. The full moon glows overhead, stars scattered wide, the scene deeply peaceful, warm, and sleepy.

pages.text: Maya and Pip dove into the Pillow Fort and stacked every cushion high. "Let's practice," said Maya. She opened her mouth wide. "Ahhh!" Pip peeked inside with a pretend tiny flashlight made of one golden sparkle. "Looks wonderful in there!" Pip declared. "One very excellent gap, right on schedule." Maya burst into giggles.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Inside a magnificent cozy cave built from cushions, pillows and blankets, lit by a soft crescent moon nightlight, a five-year-old Black girl with curly dark hair in two puffs, wearing yellow star pajamas, leans back laughing with her mouth open wide. A tiny round sky-blue dragon with stubby wings and a pale yellow belly peers in close, holding up one glowing golden sparkle like a tiny flashlight, expression earnest and funny. Warm, snug, playful mood.

pages.text: They flopped back on the softest pillow. "Now you know exactly what to do," Pip said. "Open wide, breathe slow, and be luminous." Maya nodded, already half asleep. The crescent nightlight glowed its gentlest glow. Tomorrow was just a short sleep away — and she was already so brave. Goodnight, Maya. You've got this.

wordOfTheNight.meaning: Luminous means glowing with a beautiful, warm light — even on the inside.
wordOfTheNight.example: When you smiled after being kind to someone, your whole face looked luminous.

episodeSummary: The night before her first dentist visit, Maya felt nervous about her new tooth gap. She and Pip practiced a slow breath to calm the butterflies, then either climbed Moonberry Hill to share her worry with the moon or played pretend dentist in the Pillow Fort until bravery felt easy and the worry shrank away to nothing.
